scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:vscode
scripts.cc:validate: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js validate .
scripts.cc:doctor: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js doctor .
scripts.cc:plan: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js plan --repo . --risk R1 --objective 'Validate Code Conductor planning'
scripts.build:vscode: esbuild apps/vscode/src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:vscode --sourcemap --outfile=apps/vscode/dist/extension.js && esbuild packages/cli/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --sourcemap --outfile=apps/vscode/dist/cc.js && node scripts/verify-vscode-bundle.mjs
